title: Owner Corrections: Oracle & Kombat Practice Lineage, Noncompliant Work Discard Rule, and Xbox Renderer Scope

oracle_and_kombat_practice_relationship.relationship_proven_by_git_and_binary: The oracle runner is byte-identical to the protected backup runner. The older source repository has a measured 33-commit interval, including combat/practice changes and non-hook changes; distinctive binary tags support shared lineage. Kombat Practice is a distinct executable/source snapshot with measured differences. Complete per-hook source-to-binary instruction joins and runtime activation were not established; earlier blanket inclusion claims are superseded.

hook_disabled_parity_config.scope: Requested source-intended disable configuration for pinned B9 oracle only; runtime suppression is unverified. It cannot undo unconditional legacy runtime changes, and Practice has an unconditional interception gate so it is never substituted.

oracle_and_kombat_practice_relationship.shipped_game_exclusion: All combat/practice assist hooks (auto-align, hazard snap, damage scaling, video bypasses, fatality/stance shortcuts) stay out of the shipped native port.

discard_noncompliant_work.rule: Commits, dirty files, and prior checkouts violating contract or standing rules are discarded locally (git reset / git rebase); never rewrite pushed history, never force-push, and never run git gc --prune.
discard_noncompliant_work.removed_wording: Removed obsolete 'preserve existing dirty or uncommitted work' guidance from AGENTS.md (both repos) and HANDOFF.md.

xbox_investigation_scope.scope: Limited strictly to the renderer, viewport, and HD presentation.
xbox_investigation_scope.gs_packet_decoding: Interim concession only, not a final target.

corrected_complete_instruction_set.phase_order: 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 -> 6 -> 7; each predecessor committed, pushed, baseline-passing, ledger-synced and oracle-manifest-verified
corrected_complete_instruction_set.protected_oracle: All existing contents immutable; explicitly recorded Phase 0 additions only
corrected_complete_instruction_set.write_scope: Repositories only, except named Phase 0 oracle additions and Phase 7 extraction into existing private-inputs
corrected_complete_instruction_set.records: Current documents in place; no new top-level documents/directories or dated notes; append existing work-item records; ignored active-fork telemetry, raw logs referenced by hash
corrected_complete_instruction_set.stopping_rule: If a phase cannot finish, commit/push verified work, record exact TASK_BOARD resume line and stop

phase0_launcher_correction.change: Legacy playable entry delegates before any old work-copy writes; historical minimal hook settings retained. Existing oracle BAT remains immutable. New source launcher uses disposable paths; pending exact additive wrapper and fresh baseline.
phase0_launcher_correction.oracle_headless_execution: OPEN: exact executable no-audio/no-window route not authenticated; no oracle game launched

tracked_original_manifest.conversion: CRLF to LF only; decoded path/size/hash map identical; source raw snapshot left unchanged

phase0_launcher_correction.telemetry: Source-authenticated passive PS2_FRAME_LOG; default input/checkpoint recording rotation and normal logs redirected into disposable tree. Observed historical input record is hash-pinned; no new game telemetry capture claimed.
